units.source_text: 夕雾回想对玉鬘说的一大篇话，深悔孟浪。

en.t: Yugiri thought back on the long speech he had made to Tamakazura and deeply regretted his rashness.

units.source_text: 但他又想：“我记得紫夫人比这一位更加艳丽动人，我总要找个机会访晤一次，即使像今天一样隔帘也好，至少可以听到她的娇声。”

en.t: But then he thought, I remember that Lady Murasaki is even more dazzling and charming than this lady; I must find a chance to visit her once, even if it is only from behind a curtain as today, so that at least I may hear her lovely voice.

units.source_text: 他怀着忐忑不安的心情，来看源氏太政大臣。

en.t: With an anxious and unsettled heart, he came to see Genji, the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 源氏出来见他，他便将玉鬘的回音转达。

en.t: When Genji came out to meet him, Yugiri conveyed Tamakazura's reply.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“如此看来，入宫之事她并不乐意。

en.t: Genji said, From the look of it, she is not pleased about entering the palace.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王等人对付女人手段高明，大约是他们用尽心思，花言巧语地向她求爱，因此她的心深深地被感动了。

en.t: Prince Hotaru and men like him are very skilled in dealing with women; they must have devoted every effort and courted her with sweet words, so her heart has been deeply moved.

units.source_text: 若果如此，教她入宫反而苦了她。

en.t: If that is so, sending her into the palace would only make her suffer.

units.source_text: 然而大原野行幸之时，她看到了皇上之后，曾经极口赞叹他的美貌。

en.t: Yet at the imperial outing to Oharano, after she saw the Emperor, she praised his beauty to the utmost.

units.source_text: 我确信青年女子只要窥见皇上一面，没有一个不愿意入宫的，因此打发她去当尚侍。”

en.t: I am convinced that any young woman who has even glimpsed the Emperor once would wish to enter the palace, and that is why I am sending her to serve as Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“不过，照这位表姐的模样，去当尚侍合适，还是当女御合适呢？

en.t: Yugiri replied, But judging from this cousin's appearance, would it be more fitting for her to become Naishi no Kami, or to become a consort?

units.source_text: 在宫中，秋好皇后地位高贵无比，弘徽殿女御也尊荣富厚，恩宠殊隆。

en.t: In the palace, Empress Akikonomu holds an incomparably exalted position, and the Kokiden consort is also honored, prosperous, and specially favored.

units.source_text: 表姐入宫之后即使也大受恩宠，但欲与她们并肩，恐怕是很难的。

en.t: Even if my cousin were greatly favored after entering the palace, it would probably be very difficult for her to stand alongside them.

units.source_text: 我又听人说：萤兵部卿亲王求婚非常诚恳。

en.t: I have also heard that Prince Hotaru's proposal of marriage is extremely earnest.

units.source_text: 虽然尚侍是女官之长，身份与女御、更衣不一样，但此时送她入宫，仿佛有意与亲王为难，他定然生气。

en.t: Although Naishi no Kami is the head of the female officials and her rank differs from that of a consort or a lower-ranking imperial lady, sending her into the palace now would seem like deliberately opposing the prince, and he would surely be angry.

units.source_text: 父亲与他有手足之谊，生怕伤了感情。”

en.t: Since Father has a brotherly bond with him, I fear it would damage their feelings.

units.source_text: 他说得活像大人口气。

en.t: He spoke exactly like a grown man.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“唉，做人真难啊！

en.t: Genji said, Ah, how hard it is to live as a person.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的事，不是可以由我一人做主的。

en.t: Tamakazura's affairs are not something I alone can decide.

units.source_text: 岂知连髭黑大将也恨煞了我。

en.t: And who would have thought that even General Higekuro would come to resent me so bitterly?

units.source_text: 我每逢看到不幸的人，总觉不忍坐视，必须设法救助，为此招人怨恨，反被视为轻率，真乃冤枉之极！

en.t: Whenever I see someone unfortunate, I cannot bear to sit by and do nothing, so I try to help; yet for that I draw resentment and am treated as reckless, which is terribly unfair.

units.source_text: 她母亲临死时向我哀愿，托我照顾她的女儿，我始终不忘。

en.t: When her mother was dying, she pleaded with me and entrusted her daughter to my care, and I have never forgotten it.

units.source_text: 后来听说这女儿孤苦伶仃地住在乡下，正在愁叹父亲不去找她，我觉得非常可怜，就去接了她来。

en.t: Later, when I heard that this daughter was living lonely and helpless in the countryside, grieving that her father did not come for her, I felt great pity and brought her here.

units.source_text: 只因我对她爱护周至，内大臣便也重视她了。”

en.t: It was only because I protected her so carefully that the Inner Minister also came to value her.

units.source_text: 他这番话说得头头是道。

en.t: Everything he said was perfectly reasonable.

units.source_text: 接着又说：“照她的人品，嫁与萤兵部卿亲王实甚适当。

en.t: He then continued, Given her character, it would indeed be very suitable for her to marry Prince Hotaru.

units.source_text: 此女子姿色入时，体态婀娜，加之性情贤惠，决不会有不端行为。

en.t: This young woman has a fashionable beauty and graceful figure, and moreover she is virtuous by nature, so she would never behave improperly.

units.source_text: 夫妻之间一定是很相得的。

en.t: As husband and wife, they would surely be very well matched.

units.source_text: 然而叫她入宫，也是十分合格，毫无缺陷的。

en.t: Yet having her enter the palace would also be entirely fitting and without any flaw.

units.source_text: 容貌美丽，态度可爱，礼仪都很熟悉，办事又精明能干。

en.t: She is beautiful in appearance, charming in manner, well versed in etiquette, and clever and capable in handling affairs.

units.source_text: 完全符合皇上求贤之旨呢。”

en.t: She perfectly accords with the Emperor's wish to find a worthy woman.

units.source_text: 夕雾听了这赞扬之词，想探悉父亲的真心，乘机说道：“年来父亲对她爱护如此周至，外人却都误解，说父亲自有用意呢。

en.t: Hearing these words of praise, Yugiri wanted to probe his father's true feelings, so he took the chance to say, For years Father has protected her so carefully, but outsiders have misunderstood and say Father must have some private intention.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将托人向内大臣说亲，内大臣回答他的也是这样的话。”

en.t: When General Higekuro asked someone to propose the match to the Inner Minister on his behalf, the Inner Minister gave him the same sort of reply.

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“从各方面说来，这个人由我抚养，总是不相称的。

en.t: Genji laughed and said, From every point of view, it is not really fitting that I should be the one raising her.

units.source_text: 无论入宫或其他行动，总须得内大臣许可，照他的意思做才是。

en.t: Whether she enters the palace or takes any other course, we must obtain the Inner Minister's permission and act according to his wishes.

units.source_text: 女子有三从之义。

en.t: A woman is bound by the principle of the three obediences.

units.source_text: 不守此礼，而由我做主，是不应该的。”

en.t: It would not be right to ignore that custom and have me make the decision.

units.source_text: 夕雾又说：“听说内大臣私下在议论呢，他说：‘太政大臣家里已经有了好几位身份高贵的夫人。

en.t: Yugiri said again, I hear that the Inner Minister has been saying privately, The Grand Minister already has several high-ranking ladies in his household.

units.source_text: 他不便叫玉鬘和她们同列，所以装作放弃，把她让给了我；同时又派她入宫去当个闲散的女官，以便经常把她笼闭在自己家中。

en.t: It would be awkward for him to place Tamakazura alongside them, so he pretended to give her up and handed her over to me; at the same time, he sent her into the palace as an idle female official so that he could keep her shut up in his own house as often as possible.

units.source_text: 如此安排，实甚聪明。’这是可靠的人告诉我的。”

en.t: This arrangement is truly clever. A reliable person told me this.

units.source_text: 他说得非常明确。

en.t: He spoke with great clarity.

units.source_text: 源氏推想内大臣可能有这种想法，心中颇感不快，说道：“这样瞎猜，真讨厌！

en.t: Genji imagined that the Inner Minister might indeed think this way, and feeling rather displeased, he said, Such wild guessing is truly unpleasant.

units.source_text: 此人有个脾气，万事都要穷究到底，故有这种想法。

en.t: That man has a habit of probing everything to the bottom, and that is why he has such thoughts.

units.source_text: 此事如何解决，不久自会水落石出。

en.t: How this matter will be settled will soon become clear of itself.

units.source_text: 他实在太多心了。”

en.t: He really worries far too much.

units.source_text: 说着笑起来。

en.t: As he said this, he began to laugh.

units.source_text: 他的口气十分坦率，然而夕雾仍多怀疑。

en.t: His tone was very frank, yet Yugiri still had many doubts.

units.source_text: 源氏自己也在想：“难道我真是这样的么？

en.t: Genji himself was also thinking, Can it be that I really am like that?

units.source_text: 如果被人猜中，实在太不成话，太没面子了。

en.t: If someone has guessed the truth, it is really disgraceful and deeply embarrassing.

units.source_text: 我总须设法教内大臣知道我心地清白。”

en.t: I must somehow make the Inner Minister understand that my heart is innocent.

units.source_text: 他企图打发玉鬘入宫，以遮外人耳目而掩饰自己的暧昧心情。

en.t: He had tried to send Tamakazura into the palace in order to distract outsiders and conceal his own ambiguous feelings.

units.source_text: 不料此计已被内大臣察破，想起了好生懊恼。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the Inner Minister had already seen through this plan, and when Genji thought of it, he felt deeply vexed.
